subtitle: Define reusable requests with placeholders, encrypted secrets, and testable response validation.

hints.key: It is generated automatically from the name.
hints.url: Use {{param}} for dynamic values and {{secret.name}} for encrypted secrets.
hints.urlDetectedParams: This panel only shows variables detected inside the URL. The full catalog lives in the variables manager.
hints.params: The builder detects placeholders automatically. Adjust type and optionality here.
hints.headers: You can mix fixed values, params, and secrets in both key and value.
hints.body: The body is stored as canonical JSON. You can edit it from raw JSON or the visual builder.
hints.responseSchema: Define the structure from an example, the visual builder, or the latest successful test.
hints.secrets: Every {{secret.*}} placeholder is encrypted in the backend and never returned in plaintext.
hints.forcedRequired: Required because it is used in the domain or path.
hints.optionalSupported: If an optional value is missing, that node is omitted.
hints.http2xx: Any response in the 200-299 range is considered successful.
hints.testInputs: Provide values for detected params and execute the full request.
hints.testInspection: Inspect the final rendered request and the real response.

schemaModal.title: Response Schema Builder

schemaModal.sampleHint: Paste a valid example of the expected JSON response.

schemaModal.emptySchemaDescription: Open the builder to load an example, compose the structure, or reuse the latest test.
schemaModal.emptyTestDescription: Run the API in step 4 and then come back here to use that responseBody as the schema.

variablesModal.title: Dynamic System Variables
variablesModal.description: Manage auto-detected variables and manual variables available under vars.*.
variablesModal.helper: Variables detected from URL, headers, and body are recalculated automatically. You can also add manual variables here to use them in expressions as vars.name.
variablesModal.manualHint: Manual variables only live under vars.* and do not interpolate the request URL, headers, or body.
variablesModal.empty: No dynamic variables have been detected yet.
